metadata.title: Phase 6 connector catalogue research — pre-import candidates
metadata.units: SI mass kg; breaking/WLL N; diameter mm as geometry
dataset_notes: This is independent manually curated research, not a shipped app database.
Nominal MBS and BL are stored as source nomenclature. Never infer assembly strength by adding parallel components.
No load case strength is to be inferred without manufacturer-supported configuration and contact geometry.
Peguet CE-WLL kg figures are converted as kgf with g0=9.80665 N/kg; EN products have separate IDs.
For missing data use null, not zero; flag conflicting supplier data for review.

assemblies.name: Segment connection kit, two 4mm soft shackles and two thimbles
assemblies.configuration: two independent 4mm soft shackles, each double wrapped through four sewn loops, two soft thimbles
assemblies.notes: Individual double-wrap connector MBS 55 kN is not automatically assembly MBS; load sharing and assembly testing would be needed for a combined strength.

assemblies.name: Segment connection kit, two 5mm soft shackles and two thimbles
assemblies.configuration: two 5 mm soft shackles and two soft thimbles, exact loading as manufacturer product description
assemblies.notes: Source copy says 5 mm/43 g but its legacy technical block lists 4 mm/36 g strength values. Separate standalone 5mm shackle lists 30 g EACH, which conflicts with whole-kit 43 g for two plus thimbles. Do not link a standalone SKU or import combined MBS/WLL until clarified; included only for conflict review.

sewn_connections.name: Type X sewn connection on pinkTube or LSDTube set
sewn_connections.notes: Manufacturer lists MBS X-Connection 12+ kN on named specific Type-X assemblies; this is a lower-bound claim, NOT universal TypeX rating and NOT exact measured MBS.

sewn_connections.name: Type X main-to-backup sewn connection
sewn_connections.configuration: T-stitched eyelet main-to-backup connection; nominal compatibility depends on exact webbing
sewn_connections.notes: Page claims retaining 90–100% of original webbing MBS; this does not establish quantified transverse/seam strength for arbitrary line combinations. No mass given.

sewn_connections.name: Type X center sewing
sewn_connections.configuration: sewn main-to-backup center connection, strength depends on attached webbings / sewn configuration
sewn_connections.notes: Product description confirms intended topology but supplies no unambiguous standalone seam breaking-load value. Do not reuse webbing MBS as seam MBS.

source_conflicts_for_review.issue: Seller publishes conflicting strengths for 8 mm zinc-plated quick link
source_conflicts_for_review.details: One product page says 8 mm 25 kN in overview and 35 kN in table; another lists 8 mm 25 kN and same 77 g. These may be different EN variants but must be disambiguated by SKU/manufacturer/certification. Do not merge them into a generic 8 mm record.

source_conflicts_for_review.issue: Supplier 8mm stainless product strength terminology ambiguous
source_conflicts_for_review.details: Source lists 38 kN MBS, 25 kN CE-certified breaking load, 10 kN WLL on one entry. Preserve fields as differing published ratings and request test/certification method before import.

source_conflicts_for_review.issue: Five-mm BC segment kit appears inconsistent
source_conflicts_for_review.details: Descriptive product and quick specs mention 5mm and 43g; legacy technical section displays 4mm / 36g and 32/55kN, and separately sold 5mm shackles have 30g minimum each. Do not assume kit uses the same standalone SKU or assign strength from this inconsistent technical block.

source_conflicts_for_review.issue: Sewn connectors not characterized by one universal MBS
source_conflicts_for_review.details: TypeX needs webbing pair, seam pattern, direction, manufacturer batch, measured method and orientation. Keep unknown mass and numeric limits unless sourced for exact assembly.
